fields.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) makes Peralta Community College District a partner in the Golden State Pathways Program consortium grant project, performing services listed in the MOU. The amount is capped at $354,673.80, or $88,668.45 a year for 2025-26, 2026-27, 2027-28 and 2028-29 per the MOU's consortium budget. The term is July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2029.

26-0268.sourceIssue: The official text prints the total as $354.673.80 and lists yearly amounts for 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2028-29 but omits 2027-28; the MOU's Appendix M budget shows $88,668.45 in each of four years, totaling $354,673.80.
